import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys

SOCK = "/run/bench70948748/containerd/containerd.sock"
pid, out = sys.argv[1:3]


def cri(*args):
    r = subprocess.run(["sudo", "crictl", "--runtime-endpoint", "unix://" + SOCK, "--image-endpoint", "unix://" + SOCK, *args],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    return r


def record(d):

    d = json.loads(r.stdout)
    owner = dict(record(json.loads(r.stdout)), container_id=cid[:13])
